moving_measure_cells.scope: Atomic grid models of the exact cell identity and energy inequality; atoms do not satisfy the continuum AD hypotheses. Oscillating control loses second moments without compactness.

seed_charging.scope: Full eligible-pair charge construction, overlapping seeds and nonuniform masses; does not prove geometric flat-seed or oscillation estimates.

clock_thinning.scope: Exact exponential-race law and r=p=2 compensation with vectors orthogonal on independent sets; not the source finite Fourier estimate.

probability_transfer.scope: Exact mixture inequality and numerical logarithmic blending. Band-limited majorant construction and source relative-drop bounds are not tested.

scalar_pairing.scope: Exact rational atomic measures with overlapping support and shared descendants; no disk estimates. Zero signed mass can carry positive cancellation cost.

particle_births.scope: Finite positive path measures, exact up to floating-point tolerance; no spatial label process or analytic switch packing.

nested_projection_products.scope: Random real matrix families, checking all input vectors through operator norms. Does not certify the later analytic compression lemma.

two_earliest_expansion.scope: Exact finite algebra only. No claim that arbitrary approximants have vanishing terminal remainders or the source pairwise form-norm decay.

limitations: Finite algebra, numerical inequalities and models only. No full analytic theorem or Lean solution was certified.
